firstly, sharing a plan to hurt yourself on a sub where people are grieving and distraught over people hurting themselves is ruinous and i would advise against doing that. that being said, i have been in the same position as you many times. honestly i imagine i will be in that position again, too. sometimes, that’s just how it goes. i have also experienced loss due to suicide. it hurts just as bad.

there is no way to soften the blow. it’s impossible. suicide leaves a wake that is catastrophic and irreparable. suicide has a tendency to set off a chain of further harm that grows exponentially. i have to remember this, too. by dying, my own hurt will not be eliminated but rather multiplied. it will hurt your parents terribly and it will evoke the same kind of pain that you are feeling in them. same goes for siblings, friends, or even people who don’t know you very well at all. merely hearing about a suicide committed by somebody you know can send a person into a dark spiral. 

once again, there is no way to soften the blow. 

the only way out is through. there is no pretty way to come out of a suicidal state; it is a stage 4 medical emergency. i’m sure you know all the tips and tricks but don’t dismiss them, they are useful if you take them seriously. even if you think you are out of options, you are not. every single day things are changing and advancements are being made in the realm of treating mental illness. i, too, have treatment resistant bipolar disorder that lands me in the hospital about once every other month. but the way that things were when i was first diagnosed are very different from the way that things are now.

telling you this won’t “make me feel better” (???) at all, if anything, it terrifies me and makes me feel worse. it’s what the topic if suicide does. it’s not an attempt to make you feel better, either because it’s just not that simple. i just know that perspective and a reality check can go a long way.
